what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved a scenic road permit for 780 Northfield Road after debate over the width of the stone wall opening.
The board closed the public hearing on 225 and 259 Leominster-Shirley Road and will deliberate from a draft decision at its next meeting.
The board heard a presentation on the state's MBTA Communities zoning requirement, including that noncompliance could cut access to state grant programs.
The board discussed who would pay for a possible long private sewer extension and how betterments would be assessed along a public line.
The board agreed to get the master plan request for proposals out soon after town meeting, and set its next meeting for April 11th.

why_it_matters: The MBTA Communities rule ties zoning to access to housing choice grants, local capital project funds and MassWorks, so a zoning vote could affect state money the town has used.
Sewer extension and betterment questions bear on who pays for infrastructure: the property owners along a line, or the public.

The draft decision on 225 and 259 Leominster-Shirley Road, due for deliberation at the next meeting.
